content.content:
# Change request 27 for the notes app

The app in this directory already implements the notes app. Everything it does today must keep working, with and
without JavaScript, unless this request changes it. Change the following.

## Undo for Delete selected
- `Delete selected` can now be undone, like a single delete. This replaces the rule of change 13 that a bulk delete
  cannot be undone and clears any `Undo` message.
- After `Delete selected`, the list page shows, in the element with `role="status"`, the text `Deleted "<title>"`
  when one note was deleted, or `Deleted <n> notes` when several were, and a button `Undo`.
- `Undo` puts every one of those notes back exactly as it was: title, body, number, place in the list, pin,
  `Added` date and the users it was shared with. The message then disappears.
- As before, only the most recent delete (single or selected) can be undone, and the message stays (also across a
  reload) until `Undo`, until the user's notes change again, or until the user signs out.
- Undoing `Delete selected` also works with JavaScript disabled.
{
  "name": "app",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "hozu dev",
    "check": "hozu check",
    "start": "hozu serve",
    "build": "hozu build"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@hozu/adapter-node": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/cli": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/core": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/css": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/data": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/runtime-server": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/schema-zod": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/transform": "^0.17.1",
    "zod": "^4.6.5"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@hozu/dev": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/testing": "^0.17.1",
    "@types/node": "^22.20.4",
    "typescript": "^7.0.2"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.18"
  }
}

我已完成 change 27：**「Delete selected」現在可以 Undo**，做法和單筆刪除相同。 ## 執行步驟 1. 讀 `change.md`，以及現有單筆刪除與 Undo 的程式（model、server、views）。 2. 確認狀態機（machine）不需要改，Undo 事件與 `undoing` 狀態可以直接沿用。 3. 修改 3 個檔案，再跑 `hozu check`、`hozu browse --js both`，並啟動正式伺服器實際測試。 ## 修改內容 | 檔案 | 改了什麼 | |---|---| | `features/notes/server.ts` | **「最近一次刪除」改成可存多筆**：每筆記下筆記本身和它在清單中的原始位置。
• **Delete selected**：記錄所有被刪的筆記，不再清掉 Undo 訊息。如果實際沒刪到任何筆記，維持原本行為（清掉訊息）。
• **Undo**：照原始位置由前往後放回，所以標題、內容、編號、置頂、`Added` 日期、分享對象和清單順序都和刪除前一樣。 | | `features/notes/model.ts` | `lastDeleted` 多回傳 `count`（刪了幾筆），並更新原本寫著「批次刪除不能還原」的註解。 | | `features/notes/views.ts` | `role="status"` 區塊：刪 1 筆顯示 `Deleted ""`，刪多筆顯示 `Deleted <n> notes`，旁邊有 `Undo` 按鈕。 | ## 驗證結果 - **`hozu check`**：0 個錯誤，合約 6/6 通過，lock 不需更新。6 個 HZ090 警告是修改前就有的，與這次無關。 - **`hozu browse --js both`（開與關 JavaScript 都測）**： - 刪除 2 筆（1 筆置頂、1 筆有分享給 bob）→ 顯示 `Deleted 2 notes`。重新整理後訊息還在。按 Undo 後兩筆回到原位，置頂與分享都在，bob 那邊的「Shared with me」也恢復。 - 只選 1 筆刪除 → 顯示 `Deleted "Third"`，可以 Undo。 - 單筆刪除與 Undo 照常運作。 - 刪除後再新增筆記、刪除後登出再登入，訊息都會消失。 - 沒有錯誤，有 JS 和沒 JS 的結果一致。 - **正式伺服器**：`PORT=4814 npm start` 正常啟動，`/login` 回應 200，測完已停止。 ## 已知限制 - **Undo 紀錄存在記憶體**：重新啟動伺服器後就無法 Undo。這是原本的設計，這次沒有改。 - **停止伺服器的方式**：我用 `pkill -f "hozu serve"` 停止，不是用 PID。機器上另一個 `hozu serve`（另一個目錄、port 4813）仍在執行，沒有受影響。 ## 下一步建議 1. **自己點一次**：執行 `npm run dev`，在 `/notes` 選幾筆按 Delete selected，再按 Undo，確認文字和行為符合預期。 2. **處理 HZ090 警告**：`listNotes`、`listShared` 等使用者資料的查詢仍設定 `access: 'anyone'`，建議改成 `'signedIn'`，權限較明確。 3. **提交變更**：確認沒問題後，用「change 27: undo for Delete selected」之類的訊息提交這 3 個檔案。
